tools.name: faceless_get_me
tools.description: Identify the caller. Returns the team this API key belongs to, its credit balance, subscription plan and the scopes granted to the key. Call this first to verify authentication and discover the team context every other operation runs in.

tools.name: faceless_get_credits
tools.description: Credit balance and history. Returns the team's current credit balance and a paginated ledger of credit transactions (purchases, subscription grants, video spends, refunds). Video creation charges credits at creation time; rendering and publishing are free. Costs: storyboard 20, motion_lite 50, motion_pro 100 credits per video.

tools.name: faceless_buy_credits
tools.description: Buy a credit pack with an agent payment token. Buys a credit pack and adds the credits to the team immediately, paid with a Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_...) that the customer approved in their Link agent wallet. Packs: pack_10 ($10, 100 credits), pack_25 ($25, 275), pack_50 ($50, 600); active subscribers get more credits per pack at their plan rate. Request the token for the Faceless.so Stripe profile (profile_61UDMKC11wsLfeXaMA6UDMKCL0SQKAF3aHKCFz33IPL6) with a USD max_amount of at least the pack price. Tokens are single use: retrying with the same token never charges twice. A declined, expired or already used token returns 402 payment_failed.

packId.description: Credit pack to buy: pack_10 ($10), pack_25 ($25) or pack_50 ($50)

paymentToken.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token granted to Faceless.so by the customer's agent wallet

tools.name: faceless_create_video
tools.description: Create a faceless video from a script. Creates an AI faceless video from a finished narration script: TTS voiceover, AI-generated visuals per scene, captions and optional background music. Generation is asynchronous; the response returns the video id immediately. Poll GET /videos/{id}/status until status is completed, then call POST /videos/{id}/render to produce the final MP4. Credits are charged now, at creation.

script.description: The full narration script the video is generated from

voiceId.description: TTS voice id for the narration. Full list: GET /voices

model.description: Generation model: storyboard (20 credits, static scenes), motion_lite (50, animated transitions), motion_pro (100, cinematic)

style.description: Visual style for generated imagery. Full list: GET /options?kind=styles

language.description: Script language, e.g. English. Full list: GET /options?kind=languages

name.description: Project name; defaults to the start of the script

enableBackgroundMusic.description: Mix background music under the narration

masterStyle.description: Extra style directive applied to every generated scene

globalNegativePrompt.description: Things the image model should avoid in every scene

tools.name: faceless_create_caption_video
tools.description: Caption an existing video or audio file. Creates a project from a video or audio URL you already have: transcribes it, adds styled captions and emojis, and makes it editable. Use this to caption existing footage rather than generate new AI visuals (for that, use POST /videos). Processing is asynchronous; poll GET /videos/{id}/status.

videoUrl.description: Public URL of the video file to caption

audioUrl.description: Public URL of an audio file to turn into a captioned video

language.description: Spoken language of the file, e.g. English

tools.name: faceless_list_videos
tools.description: List the team's videos. Returns a paginated list of the team's video projects, newest first, with generation status and the rendered MP4 URL when available.

tools.name: faceless_get_video
tools.description: Get one video. Returns a single video project: script, voice, model, generation state, per-platform post metadata and the rendered MP4 URL once rendered.

tools.name: faceless_update_video
tools.description: Update a video's name or post metadata. Updates a video's name and/or its per-platform post metadata (titles, captions, descriptions). Set the metadata for every platform you intend to schedule to BEFORE calling POST /posts/schedule; scheduling rejects platforms whose metadata is missing.

madeForKids.description: YouTube's made-for-kids (COPPA) declaration. Omitted: on for kids formats (Nursery Rhymes, kids niches), not sent otherwise

youtubePost.description: YouTube post metadata; required before scheduling to YouTube

tiktokPost.description: TikTok post metadata; required before scheduling to TikTok

instagramPost.description: Instagram post metadata; required before scheduling to Instagram

xPost.description: X post metadata; required before scheduling to X

facebookPost.description: Facebook post metadata; required before scheduling to Facebook

linkedinPost.description: LinkedIn post metadata; required before scheduling to LinkedIn

threadsPost.description: Threads post metadata; required before scheduling to Threads

tools.name: faceless_select_video_thumbnail
tools.description: Choose which thumbnail a video uses. Selects one of the video's thumbnail variants as the effective thumbnail. Read the available variants from GET /videos/{id} (the thumbnails object). The choice is marked as a user pick, so later automatic regenerations will not overwrite it, and it is what gets pushed to YouTube and used as the Instagram Reels cover at post time. Thumbnails are free and generated automatically after a video completes.

variantId.description: Variant id from the thumbnails.variants array on GET /videos/{id}

tools.name: faceless_get_video_status
tools.description: Poll video generation progress. Returns generation progress for a video: overall status (pending, processing, completed, failed), percent complete, per-step events and any error messages. Poll every 10-30 seconds after POST /videos until status is completed, then render it with POST /videos/{id}/render. A failed generation refunds nothing automatically; check errorMessages.

tools.name: faceless_render_video
tools.description: Render a video to MP4. Starts a cloud render of a generated video and returns a renderId. Rendering is asynchronous: poll GET /renders/{renderId} until status is done to get the MP4 URL. The video must have finished generating first (getVideoStatus status completed). Rendering is free; credits were charged at creation.

tools.name: faceless_delete_video
tools.description: Delete a video. Permanently deletes a video project and its generated assets. This cannot be undone and does not refund credits.

tools.name: faceless_get_render
tools.description: Poll render progress. Returns the progress of a render started by POST /videos/{id}/render: status in-progress (with overallProgress 0-1), done (with the final MP4 url) or error. Poll every 5-15 seconds; renders typically take under two minutes.

tools.name: faceless_create_series
tools.description: Create an automated video series. Creates a series that automatically generates and posts a new faceless video on a schedule (a set-and-forget channel). Choose a content source and niche or custom prompt, a voice, style and posting cadence; each generated episode charges credits like a single video. The first episode starts generating right after creation. Use GET /series/{id}/episodes to track output, POST /series/{id}/generate to force the next episode now.

name.description: Series name shown in the dashboard

source.description: Content source that scripts every episode, e.g. "Facts & stories", "Reddit post", "Custom prompt". Full list: GET /options?kind=sources

niche.description: Content niche, e.g. scary stories, motivation. Full list: GET /options?kind=niches

customPrompt.description: Custom topic prompt used instead of (or alongside) a niche

voice.description: TTS voice id for narration. Full list: GET /voices

style.description: Visual style for generated imagery. Full list: GET /options?kind=styles

language.description: Video language, e.g. English. Omitted on create, it is the voice's own language when the voice is made for one language (a Spanish voice gives Spanish), else English. Full list: GET /options?kind=languages

duration.description: Target episode length in seconds (30, 60 or 90)

destination.description: Primary auto-post destination platform, e.g. youtube or tiktok

youtube.description: youtube account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so youtube posts through the team's default account

tiktok.description: tiktok account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so tiktok posts through the team's default account

instagram.description: instagram account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so instagram posts through the team's default account

facebook.description: facebook account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so facebook posts through the team's default account

x.description: x account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so x posts through the team's default account

threads.description: threads account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so threads posts through the team's default account

linkedin.description: linkedin account ids to post through; [] clears the pin so linkedin posts through the team's default account

anyOf.description: Deprecated flat list of account ids; each id is filed under the platform it is an account of

destinationAccounts.description: Which connected account each platform posts through, by platform, e.g. {"youtube":["<authId>"],"tiktok":["<authId>"]} with authIds from GET /accounts. Every id must be an account of this team on that platform, or the request is rejected. A platform with no entry posts through the team's default account. On update only the platforms you send change; null clears every pin

generateThumbnails.description: Generate 3 AI thumbnail variants for every episode and auto-select the best. Free. Defaults to true.

styleHint.description: Free-text art direction for the thumbnail backgrounds, e.g. "moody neon, close-up faces"

thumbnailSettings.description: Thumbnail generation options. Ignored when generateThumbnails is false.

autoPostTime.description: Daily auto-post time "HH:mm" in the series timezone

postingDays.description: Days of the week to post as numbers, 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday, e.g. [1,3] for Monday and Wednesday. Omit for every day

timezone.description: IANA timezone for scheduling, e.g. America/New_York

youtube.description: "HH:mm" youtube posts at instead of autoPostTime

tiktok.description: "HH:mm" tiktok posts at instead of autoPostTime

instagram.description: "HH:mm" instagram posts at instead of autoPostTime

facebook.description: "HH:mm" facebook posts at instead of autoPostTime

x.description: "HH:mm" x posts at instead of autoPostTime

threads.description: "HH:mm" threads posts at instead of autoPostTime

linkedin.description: "HH:mm" linkedin posts at instead of autoPostTime

platformPostTimes.description: Post one platform at a different time of day, in the series timezone and on the same posting days, e.g. {"youtube":"09:05"}. Useful because YouTube's shared daily upload limit resets at midnight US Pacific. null clears it

captionStyle.description: Caption theme name. Full list: GET /options?kind=captionThemes

subreddit.description: Subreddit to pull posts from when source is "Reddit post"

backgroundVideo.description: Background gameplay/footage id. Full list: GET /options?kind=backgrounds

useRandomBackgroundVideo.description: Pick a random background video per episode

brollModel.description: Generation model for visuals: storyboard, motion_lite or motion_pro

enableBackgroundMusic.description: Mix background music under the narration

enableVoiceover.description: Story Slides and News Slides only: an AI voice reads each slide, using `voice` (a default voice when omitted). Defaults to false (music only)

slidesLength.description: Story Slides and News Slides only: episode length. "short" (about 20s, 5-6 slides, the default), "medium" (about 40s, about 12 slides) or "long" (about 60s, about 18 slides). Each slide stays on screen just as long, so longer means more slides. Priced per slide: medium costs 2x and long 3x the short price

backgroundMusicMood.description: Background music mood. Full list: GET /options?kind=music

scriptureTranslation.description: Bible translation scripture is quoted from word for word: kjv, web or drb. null follows the brief, else kjv

youtubeMadeForKids.description: Declare auto-posted YouTube videos as made for kids (COPPA). Omitted: on for kids formats (Nursery Rhymes, bedtime-stories, good-morals, kids language lessons), not sent otherwise

tiktokPrivacyLevel.description: Who can see auto-posted TikTok posts: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE (the default), MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS or SELF_ONLY. A private TikTok account posts to its followers when PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE is asked

tiktokAllowComments.description: Allow comments on auto-posted TikTok posts; defaults to true. An account that has comments disabled in TikTok posts with them off

episodeTitleMode.description: How episodes are titled when they post. "unique" (the default): every episode posts its own title. "series_numbered": every episode posts as "<seriesDisplayTitle> - Episode N" on YouTube, and every other platform's caption opens with that line above the episode's usual caption. N is the episode's place in a serial (Micro Drama) or the next number of the series, and never changes once an episode is made

seriesDisplayTitle.description: The series title numbered episodes carry. Empty uses a serial's own story title, then the series name

episodeTitleSeparator.description: What joins the series title and the episode number: hyphen ("Title - Episode 1", the default), em_dash, pipe ("Title | Episode 1") or colon ("Title: Episode 1")

tools.name: faceless_list_series
tools.description: List the team's series. Returns all automated series for the team with their source, niche, cadence and pause state.

tools.name: faceless_get_series

paused.description: Pause or resume automatic episode generation

seasonEndsOn.description: Season end: the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the series timezone) a new episode is scheduled for. No episode is made or charged for a later slot, episodes already made still post, and after the last one posts the series pauses itself with seasonFinished true. null removes the season end

tools.name: faceless_delete_series
tools.description: Delete a series. Deletes a series and stops all future automatic generation. Already-generated videos are kept.

tools.name: faceless_generate_series_episode
tools.description: Generate the next episode now. Immediately generates the next episode of a series instead of waiting for its schedule. Charges the series' per-episode credit cost. The episode appears in GET /series/{id}/episodes; poll the created video's status like any other video.

tools.name: faceless_list_series_episodes
tools.description: List a series' episodes. Returns the videos generated by a series, newest first, with their generation status, scheduled post time and posted state.

tools.name: faceless_publish_post
tools.description: Publish a rendered video to a platform now. Immediately publishes a rendered video to one connected platform (youtube, tiktok, instagram, x, facebook, linkedin or threads). The video must be rendered first (renderedVideoUrl present, or pass videoUrl explicitly) and the team must have that platform connected (GET /accounts). Every connected account gets a video once: publishing it again to an account that already has it answers 409 conflict unless allowRepost is true. For future-dated posting use POST /posts/schedule instead.

platform.description: Destination platform; must be connected (see GET /accounts)

title.description: Post title or caption (platform-appropriate); falls back to the video's stored post metadata

description.description: Longer description for platforms that support one (YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn)

madeForKids.description: YouTube only: declare the video made for kids (COPPA). Omitted: the video's stored choice, else on for kids formats, else not sent

tiktokPrivacyLevel.description: TikTok only: who can see the post; defaults to PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE (followers, on a private TikTok account)

tiktokAllowComments.description: TikTok only: allow comments on the post; defaults to true. An account that has comments disabled in TikTok posts with them off

authId.description: Specific connected account id when the team has several for the platform (from GET /accounts)

allowRepost.description: Post it again even though this video is already on that channel or account. Without it, a repeat is refused with 409 conflict and nothing is posted

tools.name: faceless_schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a video to one or more platforms. Schedules a video to be rendered (if needed) and posted to multiple platforms at a future time. Every platform in the list must have its post metadata already set on the video (PATCH /videos/{id}); the request is rejected otherwise. Cancel with DELETE /posts/{videoId}. See the posting calendar with GET /calendar.

platforms.description: Platforms to post to; each needs its post metadata set on the video first

tools.name: faceless_post_now
tools.description: Post a scheduled video now instead of at its scheduled time. Brings a scheduled video forward to now: every pending posting task of the video (and its render, if that is what is still waiting) moves to the current time and goes out within a minute or two, to every platform it was scheduled for. Works for videos scheduled with POST /posts/schedule and for series episodes waiting for their slot. It does not post a video that was never scheduled (use POST /posts), a video that still needs approval (409; approve it first), or an episode of a deleted series or of one paused for any reason but credits (409; resume the series first). Returns 400 when nothing is pending.

videoId.description: The scheduled video (project) to post now

tools.name: faceless_cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled post. Cancels the pending scheduled posting for a video (the id is the video id used in POST /posts/schedule). Posts that already went out are not affected.

tools.name: faceless_get_calendar
tools.description: Posting calendar. Returns the team's social posts (scheduled, posted and failed) within a date range, across all platforms. Use it to see what is queued before scheduling more.

status.description: Filter by post status, e.g. scheduled, posted, failed

tools.name: faceless_list_accounts
tools.description: List connected social accounts. Returns the social accounts connected to the team (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads) with their ids. Use the ids as authId in publishPost and destinationAccounts in series. Connecting accounts itself happens in the dashboard (OAuth), not over the API.

tools.name: faceless_list_voices
tools.description: List TTS voices. Returns the text-to-speech voices available for narration, including the team's custom cloned voices and Recommended Studio Quality voices. Recommended ids are opaque: pass the returned id unchanged and Faceless will resolve the appropriate ElevenLabs model. Use a voice's id as voiceId in createVideo or voice in createSeries.

tools.name: faceless_list_options
tools.description: List content option catalogs. Enumerates the option catalogs used by createVideo and createSeries: sources, styles, niches, languages, durations, models (with credit costs), captionThemes, music moods, background videos and example subreddits. Call without kind to list the available kinds; pass kind to get that catalog's items.

kind.description: Which catalog to return; omit to list available kinds

tools.name: faceless_create_asset
tools.description: Register a media asset by URL. Registers an already-hosted media file (video, image or audio URL) as a team asset usable in projects. This endpoint takes a URL, not raw bytes; host the file anywhere public (or use the dashboard for direct uploads).

url.description: Public URL of the media file

tools.name: faceless_get_analytics
tools.description: Cross-platform posting analytics. Returns aggregated performance for the team's published posts (views, likes, comments and posting volume) across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook, over a trailing window.
